articles.summary: Origin Bank today announced Walt Stephens has joined the company as executive vice president and Mississippi state president. Stephens brings more than 16 years of banking experience, with expertise in commercial and middle-market banking, agricultural finance, business development and relationship management.
articles.title: Origin Bank Names Walt Stephens Mississippi State | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bank has been named one of American Banker’s 2026 Best Banks to Work For, marking its 14th consecutive year to be recognized by the program. Initiated in 2013 by American Banker and Best Companies Group, the program identifies and honors banks that excel at creating positive and supportive workplaces for employees.
articles.title: Origin Bank Recognized by American Banker as | Origin Bank

articles.summary: RUSTON, La. — Origin Bancorp, Inc. (TXSE: OBK) (“Origin”), the holding company for Origin Bank, today announced the promotion of Derek McGee to Chief Operating Officer. McGee joined Origin in January 2022 as Senior Executive Officer and Chief Legal Counsel after serving as a trusted outside advisor to the company for more than a decade.
